messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the public‑holiday long weekends in Canada for 2023 (dates are based on the federal statutory holidays; provincial variations may apply):

| Long Weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) – Jan 2 (Mon) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday, so the observed holiday is Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Observed on the third Monday of February. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Apr 7 (Fri) – Apr 10 (Mon) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday; Easter Monday is a federal holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day | Jul 1 (Tue) – Jul 3 (Thu) | Canada Day falls on Tuesday, so the observed holiday is Thursday, Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Mon) | Observed on the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day & Boxing Day | Dec 25 (Mon) – Dec 27 (Wed) | Christmas on Monday, Boxing Day on Tuesday; the observed holiday is Wednesday, Dec 27. |

These are the federal statutory holidays that create long weekends. Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, National Indigenous Peoples Day in British Columbia, etc.) that could also give extra days off. If you’d like a province‑specific list or need the data in a particular format (CSV, JSON, etc.), just let me know!
